checks.a2_words: Every word of every script is on the A2 list or a transparent compound; 'intake' replaced. Compounds judged: leesuur (lees + uur, glossed by the next sentence), basketbaldag (basketbal + dag), personeelspas (personeel + pas, 'pas' repeated in options), lentebeurt (lente + beurt, glossed by the list of checks), rijschool and autorijden (rijles is listed). Listed words that are still demanding in context: loonstrook, verdieping, rotonde, monteur, zenuwachtig; each is explained by context and no question depends on it alone.
checks.key_balance: A 10 (29%), B 11 (31%), C 12 (34%), D 2 (6%, of 8 four-option questions). No letter above 40% or below 20% among A-C. Keys never repeat three times in a row.
checks.option_shape: Key is not the longest option in any question after the edits (fysio q2 and rijschool q2 repaired); no polarity or day-pattern odd one out remains (woning q1, rijschool q2 repaired). Prompts no longer leak other keys (woning q3, fysio q3, huiswerk title repaired).
checks.script_as_speech: Numbers, times and prices in words; no fillers; no meaning that depends on punctuation. Voice pairings: m-young + f-adult, m-adult + f-mature, m-older + f-young; never m-adult with f-adult; two different roles in each conversation.
checks.names: Each name at most twice; no voice names or older cast used as characters. Organisations Trapkracht and Zijspiegel were searched by the author (notes section 9); I did not repeat a web search, they are generic enough and the coordinator may wish to do a quick check.

diversity: Three gesprek (work, school, housing), two voicemail (physio, library), two omroep (tram, sports hall), two uitleg (printer, language school), one nieuws, two reclame. None repeats an A2 listening title in the catalogue; items 5 and 10 (both library) should go to different practice sets; item 4 and 090 fysio-oefeningen, item 12 and 090 rijles-verzet likewise.
